name: Rod of Spell Holding
body:
Price 10,000 gp; Aura moderate no school; CL 6; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This thin copper rod is capped with an open hand. It allows the user to cast a spell with a range of touch into the rod and “hold” it, allowing them to cast other spells or using other touch effects while the charge is held in the rod. As a standard action, the rod can be used to deliver the held charge as a melee touch attack.

The rod can hold the charge for up to 6 minutes. If the duration expires or the rod leaves the user’s hand, the charge in the rod is lost. As a bonus, the rod acts as a great back scratcher.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 5,000 gp; Feats Craft Rod; Special creator must be a caster of at least 12th level
